item.description: Good morning, Sydney! It's a beautiful Sunday, May 3rd, 2026, and a big welcome to your Daily Drive. The sun's shining, promising a lovely, mild day perfect for a leisurely brunch or a coastal walk, and no major headlines to distract from your chill Sunday vibes. Remember, even the longest journey starts with a single step, so let's make that step a great one today! Have a fantastic drive and a wonderful Sunday.
